data.narrative:
Urban Sky, a Series B space and aerospace company founded by Jared Leidich and Andrew Antonio, has raised $49.9M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 5 public tickers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers in the same sector and stage, including Cowboy Space Corporation, Aalyria, and Skyryse.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis uses the $50M raised as a proxy base and applies a 1.9x multiplier typical for Series B advancement, yielding $95M. Peer-median analysis across four same-sector comparables—Sierra Space ($8.0B Series C), Cowboy Space Corporation ($2.0B Series B), Aalyria ($1.3B Series B), and Skyryse ($1.1B Series C)—produces a median of $1.6B, with a range of $1.1B to $8.0B. Public-comp anchoring is inapplicable; while the Space & Aerospace sector median P/S is 27.4x across 6 public names, Urban Sky's revenue is not disclosed.

The triangulated analysis implies a valuation range of $81M to $1.9B, with a median of $872M. This wide range reflects material uncertainty around whether Urban Sky tracks closer to early-stage capital raised multiples or to peer valuations in a sector exhibiting substantial dispersion. Revenue visibility, competitive positioning within commercial space, and path to Series C financing represent critical refinement variables.
